study: Multi-ancestry genome-wide association meta-analysis of Parkinson's disease.
ancestry: European; East Asian; Hispanic or Latin American; African unspecified
selection_note: Frozen Parkinson reference study; do not reselect.

study: New insights into the genetic etiology of Alzheimer's disease and related dementias.
selection_note: Large disease-specific GWAS with summary-statistics flag and 83 Open Targets credible sets; chromosome-specific studies excluded.
Catalog ontology has only GCST004691 for Huntington progression, not common-variant disease risk.

study: Common and rare variant association analyses in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis identify 15 risk loci with distinct genetic architectures and neuron-specific biology.
selection_note: Largest disease-specific multi-ancestry GWAS with summary statistics and Open Targets credible sets.

study: Genome sequence analyses identify novel risk loci for multiple system atrophy.
selection_note: Eligible risk GWAS exists, but current Open Targets has zero credible sets; older eligible studies also have zero.

study: Joint genome-wide association study of progressive supranuclear palsy identifies novel susceptibility loci and genetic correlation to neurodegenerative diseases.
selection_note: Largest disease-specific genome-wide array study with Open Targets credible sets.

study: Mapping genomic loci implicates genes and synaptic biology in schizophrenia.
ancestry: European; East Asian; African American or Afro-Caribbean; Hispanic or Latin American
selection_note: Large dedicated PGC disease GWAS with 222 Open Targets credible sets; generic cross-population atlas studies were not preferred.

study: Genome-wide association study of more than 40,000 bipolar disorder cases provides new insights into the underlying biology.
selection_note: Largest dedicated bipolar GWAS with usable Open Targets credible sets.

study: Bi-ancestral depression GWAS in the Million Veteran Program and meta-analysis in >1.2 million individuals highlight new therapeutic directions. (European component)
selection_note: The larger bi-ancestry record GCST90020230 has zero Open Targets credible sets; the same-publication European component has 94 and is the prespecified comparable alternative.

study: Identification of common genetic risk variants for autism spectrum disorder.
selection_note: The larger SPARK record has zero Open Targets credible sets; this disease-specific study has one, so low power is retained and flagged.

study: Genome-wide analyses of ADHD identify 27 risk loci, refine the genetic architecture and implicate several cognitive domains.
selection_note: Dedicated diagnosis GWAS with Open Targets credible sets; mixed symptom-and-diagnosis studies excluded.

study: GWAS meta-analysis of over 29,000 people with epilepsy identifies 26 risk loci and subtype-specific genetic architecture.
selection_note: Dedicated contemporary epilepsy meta-analysis; broad biobank/cross-population atlas records were not preferred.

study: Genome-wide analysis of 102,084 migraine cases identifies 123 risk loci and subtype-specific risk alleles.
selection_note: Largest dedicated migraine GWAS with extensive Open Targets credible sets; cross-trait and PheCode records excluded.

study: Multiple sclerosis genomic map implicates peripheral immune cells and microglia in susceptibility.
selection_note: Dedicated disease consortium study with 140 credible sets; larger generic biobank records were not preferred.

study: Genome-wide Association Study points to novel locus for Gilles de la Tourette Syndrome.
selection_note: Eligible risk GWAS exists, but current Open Targets has zero credible sets; older eligible studies also have zero.
